title: Thirty-Five Lay Partners Welcomed into the Redemptorist Family
excerpt: On 4 October 2026, the Bangalore Province welcomed 35 lay partners after a period of formation and a three-day retreat in Bengaluru.
body:
The Redemptorist Bangalore Province formally welcomed 35 Lay Partners in Mission on 4 October 2026. The celebration followed a programme of formation and a three-day retreat in Bengaluru focused on prayer, reflection, discernment, and sharing in the Redemptorist mission.

The new partners came from communities in different parts of India. During the Eucharistic celebration, they made their commitment to serve as Lay Partners in Mission.

Source: Read the original report on CSSR News.

title: Indian Redemptorists Hold Joint Media Training in Bangalore
excerpt: A six-day media programme brought around 20 participants together in Bangalore to learn digital storytelling and production.
body:
From 14 to 19 September 2026, a joint media-training initiative in Bangalore brought together participants from different religious congregations. The programme was organised by the Bangalore Province under the Redemptorist Media Lab.

Sessions introduced participants to photography, graphic design, videography, sound, interviewing, scriptwriting, and editing, supporting the use of digital storytelling in ministry.

title: Redemptorist Formees Gather for Fellowship and Reflection
excerpt: From 27–30 May 2026, Bangalore Province formees met at Holy Cross Parish, Muttada, Kerala, for fellowship and formation.
body:
Bangalore Province formees met at Holy Cross Parish, Muttada, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, from 27 to 30 May 2026 for formation, fellowship and renewal.

As reported by the Redemptorist news service, participants interacted with parish-based Friends of Redemptorists and Lay Partners in Mission. The programme also included reflection on safeguarding responsibilities and the structures for reporting concerns.

Source: Read the original report on CSSR News.

title: Beloved 2026: Youth Retreat at Nava Spoorthi Kendra
excerpt: About 60 young people joined a residential retreat in Bangalore from 20–22 March 2026 for prayer, reflection and fellowship.
body:
Redemptorist Youth and Vocation Ministry organised Beloved 2026, a three-day residential retreat at Nava Spoorthi Kendra in Bangalore, from 20 to 22 March 2026.

Approximately 60 young participants came together for faith-sharing, prayer, reflection, and community. The retreat was arranged with support from Holy Ghost Church and Holy Redeemer Church parish clergy.

Source: Read the original report on CSSR News.

title: Jeevanodhaya: A New Mission House in Karnataka
excerpt: The Redemptorist Bangalore Province celebrated a long-awaited mission-house initiative in Karnataka.
body:
The Redemptorist Province of Bangalore marked the inauguration of Jeevanodhaya, a mission house in Karnataka, fulfilling a long-held ambition to serve people more closely in their language, culture, and daily circumstances.

The initiative reflects the Province’s continuing commitment to mission and local communities.
